name: Conventional Deadlift

substitutions.note: more hamstring stretch, less systemic load

contraindications: disc-related symptoms provoked by spinal loading
resistance_profile: hardest off the floor; leverage improves through mid-range

provenance.notes: Coaching consensus (RP/Israetel) ranks the deadlift as the most systemically/axially fatiguing lift, but head-to-head research (Barbalho et al., JSCR 2017) found no difference in central fatigue vs. squat and MORE peripheral fatigue from the squat. 'systemic_fatigue: 5' is the heuristic default, flagged contested. Personalize from the user's own recovery data.
